research.title: Covariance Shrinkage for Prediction with Incomplete Features
bullets: Formulated how feature missingness affects covariance estimation and developed a missingness-aware shrinkage estimator for regularized linear prediction.
Designed simulations separating missingness mechanisms from feature correlation and compared predictive error against mean imputation and conventional covariance shrinkage.

research.title: Regularized Label Shift Estimation for Probability Calibration
bullets: Investigated instability in label shift correction and developed a constrained class prior estimator with regularization toward training proportions.
Evaluated corrected probabilities under controlled prevalence shifts, examining calibration error and sensitivity to misspecified class conditional distributions.

research.title: Density Ratio Stabilization for Conformal Regression under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated how unstable density ratio estimates affect weighted conformal intervals and led development of a clipping procedure guided by held-out diagnostics.
Compared coverage and interval width across synthetic shifts and tabular regression tasks, examining weight concentration, overlap violations, and conditional coverage.

work.title: Data Validation and Batch Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned Python validation routines for incoming tabular records, checking required fields, type consistency, and duplicate identifiers before batch processing.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and revised error handling to preserve diagnostic context during failed processing runs.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Probabilistic Classifier Calibration
bullets: Implemented temperature scaling and isotonic regression for classifier outputs, using separate fitting and evaluation partitions to avoid calibration leakage.
Compared reliability diagrams, log loss, and calibration error across class imbalance settings, documenting sensitivity to calibration sample composition.

projects.title: Sparse Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented coordinate descent for lasso and elastic net regression, checking optimization convergence against reference implementations on standardized feature matrices.
Compared predictive error and coefficient stability under correlated predictors, using repeated data splits and consistent cross-validation procedures for penalty selection.

projects.title: Variational and Sampling Approaches to Bayesian Regression
bullets: Implemented mean-field variational inference and Gibbs sampling for conjugate Bayesian linear regression, validating posterior summaries against analytical calculations.
Compared approximation error, convergence diagnostics, and predictive uncertainty across feature correlation settings, examining where factorized approximations distorted posterior dependence.
